comment: Which stores each harness brings (the router adds them to a session; the app hides them), and whether it runs on a Claude account (`claudeAccount`: the account picked at New session, else the default; router/claudeaccounts.go, DECISIONS 185). Sensitivity and the Fly store live in the core, not here. `tunnel` holds CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET = the Access service token jarvis2-tunnel, which the cf-tunnel Worker confines to registering Jarvis 4 session tunnels (the web UI of OpenCode/Paseo and OpenClaw; tunnel pages and drops in Claude sessions, TUNNEL_ID = the session id). openclaw, paseo-claude (Claude Code driven by Paseo) and cloudcli (Claude Code driven by CloudCLI) run on the Claude subscription, hence a Claude account.
